detail.title: H1100 Over-Ear Gaming Headphones - Frost White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports H1100 is an over-ear gaming headset built around 50mm directional drivers that position sound directly into the ear for precise, gaming-grade audio across PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch. A flip-to-mute noise-cancellation microphone keeps voice chat clear while making it easy to quickly mute during offline moments, and in-line controls let you adjust volume on the go without reaching for a software panel. Breathable memory foam ear cushions and a self-adjusting headband keep the lightweight 302g frame comfortable through extended sessions, while closed-back, 3D-draping ear cups deliver strong noise isolation to keep you focused on the game. Auto RGB lighting adds a vibrant finishing touch, and the universal 3.5mm wired connection works across virtually any gaming platform.
